facts.value: Returns0 for null config or JObj. Calls lb_8000B1CC for both endpoints of every descriptor. A pair qualifies unless both Y values are strictly above or strictly below height. Negative x10 bypasses probability; otherwise HSD_Randf()<x10 is required, without clamping. For abs(dy)>0.0001 use height intersection, otherwise random t; force output Y=height. Negative mode uses ONE shared config->gen across all segments: call callback when absent, otherwise overwrite its position; any later noncrossing segment calls grLib_801C9874 and clears it. Nonnegative mode calls callback and discards its result. Return counts accepted placements, including callback NULL returns or repositioning, not successful creations. No callback/array guards.
facts.rationale: Complete pinned canonical/rendered review with local failure and ownership boundaries.

facts.value: Requires published data and enabled bit. Scans circular indices0–80 from saved cursor, with255-iteration cap and stop on returning to start; valid start yields81 visits and unchanged final cursor. Entry must have x0!=-1 and x4==NULL. x2==-1 disables; x2>0 decrements without spawning that visit; any other nonpositive x2 proceeds. Ground_801C2D24 must succeed. Candidate must be strictly inside blast bounds; zero argument additionally excludes strict interior of the rectangle formed by averaging camera and blast bounds, while inner edges remain allowed. Markers0xDC–0xFB call Ground_801C58E0(x8,marker) if x8!=-1. Other markers require nonnull descriptor table indexed by marker-0x20, without bounds checks. Switch dispatches eight item kinds; only nonnull returns occupy entries, and ordinary items receive reciprocal zako.idx. Unsupported kind/failure leaves vacancy and timer unchanged. No null descriptor ordinary spawn occurs.
facts.rationale: Complete pinned canonical/rendered review with local failure and ownership boundaries.

facts.value: Allocates via CA67C, which first enables/reset cursor, then calls GObj_Create(2,4,0). On GObj failure reports diagnostic, frees fresh data and returnsNULL without replacing descriptor/data pointers; earlier enable/cursor changes remain. On success schedules fn_801CADBC at priority0, publishes caller descriptor pointer (including NULL) and fresh table, then returns GObj. No immediate actor or target spawn. No duplicate-init guard, old-table/old-manager cleanup, descriptor copy or owned destructor attachment appears; repeated success overwrites singleton pointers while older processes also read that singleton.
facts.rationale: Complete pinned canonical/rendered review with local failure and ownership boundaries.

Registry allocation, fallible manager publication, periodic scans, two slot-release policies, a reserved tail slot and enable/global-item cleanup are local. facts.value: Registry entries with marker!=-1 and no object are processed when enabled. Cooldown-1 disables, positive cooldown decrements without attempting creation that visit, and every other nonpositive cooldown takes the candidate path. Valid candidates require successful point lookup, strict blast bounds and, in ordinary mode, no strict inner-camera inclusion. Constructor and item-return failures do not imply occupied slots. Cleanup disables scans and visits global item kinds without registry ownership filtering or table/manager deallocation.
facts.rationale: Spawn path accepts nonpositive cooldowns other than-1, not exclusively zero; clarify full guards and cleanup scope.
